subject: Re: RE: A21071408 & A21071409// Need AMC quote
body:
Subject: Exciting Next Steps for Our Collaboration

Hi Rimpy,

Thank you again for the opportunity to work together on the recent quoting initiative. I genuinely enjoyed our collaboration and appreciate the openness you showed during our discussions about the AI Readiness Audit and potential partnership structures.

Since we last spoke, Zion Tech Group has sharpened our AI/IT services around three areas that align directly with what Techsub needs:

1) **Managed AI Support Automation** — We can deploy our AI agents to handle Tier-1/2 tickets, significantly cutting response times by over 60% and providing cleaner escalation paths to your specialists. This would be a co-branded service, allowing you to maintain your client relationships while we deliver the AI support.

2) **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments** — We can package the audit framework we discussed into a repeatable, co-branded offering that you can lead with prospects. We’ll handle the technical depth, while you own the commercial conversation, with a revenue split of 50/50 on net margin.

3) **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot** — A 30-day pilot utilizing your current environment alongside our platform to demonstrate measurable reductions in Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) and cloud cost savings. Following the pilot, we can transition to a Master Services Agreement (MSA) or Statement of Work (SOW-1) with pre-agreed pricing.

I’d love to move this forward efficiently. We can iterate on the scope via email, or if you prefer, we can lock in the commercial terms on a quick 30-minute call: [Schedule a Meeting](https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup).

Additionally, we have many free services and tools available on our website that your team can start using immediately: [Explore Our Offerings](https://ziontechgroup.com).

Which of these three directions resonates most with you? I can prepare a one-page term sheet for whichever path you prefer.

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Best,  
Kleber Garcia Alcatrão  
CEO, Zion Tech Group
